title: Port Solano
tagline: Five jobs and a five-star chase across a coastal city
description: An open-world browser crime sandbox set in the fictional coastal city of Port Solano. The source implements driving, vehicle theft, on-foot combat, police pursuit, five jobs, a day/night cycle, and synthesized audio. Submitted as a showcase with incomplete production evidence.
features: Coastal city with downtown, suburbs, parks, harbor, and beach
Fifteen vehicle types, traffic, pedestrians, and vehicle theft
Five-star wanted system with police pursuit and arrest
Five jobs spanning theft, delivery, racing, combat, and demolition
Day/night cycle, minimap, full map, and synthesized radio

controls: WASD to move or drive; mouse to look
Shift to sprint; Space to jump or use the handbrake
F to enter, exit, or steal a vehicle
Left mouse to attack; right mouse to aim; R to reload
1–5 or mouse wheel to select a weapon
E to start a job at a contact marker
H for horn or siren; Q for radio; C for camera distance
M for full map; Escape to pause
limitations: Showcase only: no benchmark handoff, exact prompt, model snapshot, reasoning level, agent counts, or isolation evidence is published.
The fictional coastal city is Port Solano, not a documented reconstruction of San Francisco.
The source uses npm and package-lock.json, without the required pnpm lockfile or build:mirage command.
The source was committed on October 7–8, 2026; the original production build date is not recorded.
No first-party code license is published; complete asset license clearance is unknown.
Features and controls are recorded from source and README. Live deployment and opaque-origin sandbox playability remain unverified.
Source PR #1 reports headless tests at about 1 FPS using injected game inputs. That does not verify real-time keyboard and mouse playability.
No contributor cover, touch support, or gamepad support is recorded.
